//: The app's tsconfig leaves JSX alone for Next to compile ('jsx': 'preserve'). These scripts render components and load server modules outside Next, so they need a transform — the automatic runtime, which is what Next itself uses — and a stand-in for `server-only`, whose whole job is to throw outside a server component. baseUrl is restated because paths resolve against it and an extended config would otherwise inherit the parent's, one directory up from here.
